long_description.body:
Throw your axe into this soft case and get to the gig! They are made with a canvas exterior, 5 mm padded interior, 2 adjustable straps, and a handy outside compartment with zipper, perfect for a strap, picks, cable, etc.





Backpack straps for hands-free carry




Canvas exterior with zippered accessory compartment




5 mm padded interior and black cloth lining




Internal dimensions: 46.89” length, 9.44” upper body width, 17.00” lower body width, 2.56” depth.
